facts.fact: The Justice Ministry portal says the digital criminal-case subsystem of the SIJ was developed by NOSi with the IMIJ and national partners and has processed about 25,000 case files and over 18,000 proceedings end to end.
NOSi, in collaboration with the IMIJ, is stated to have developed the SIJ criminal-case subsystem used by courts, police stations and Judicial Police delegations.
The SIJ criminal-case subsystem, developed by NOSi with the IMIJ, was handed over at a ceremony and is in use; no go-live date is given, so as_of is the handover date.
